metric.definition: Successful MAP at all five new indices is required; otherwise score is 1000000 + nonconverged_or_missing_count. On successful runs, use the equal-weight normalized geometric mean of mean original-covariance reduced chi-square and pooled Rh/Rv log10 RMSE.

interpretation: One 1D MDA increment often made the gate choose the cheaper 1D final fit. Field RMSE improved at most points, but data misfit at index 32 worsened and the index-34 MAP could not find an acceptable trial. This budget is not a successful transition-zone strategy.
